Advisory.description:
A security advisory as its database states it (OSV: GHSA, PyPA, RustSec, Go vulndb, ...), with its ranges resolved
centrally against the technology's release index, so the edge needs no ecosystem-specific version parsing.

affected.description: Affected versions per package; a project is affected when its version of `component` is in `range`.

aliases.description: Other ids of the same advisory (CVE, other databases).

id.description: The advisory's id: the GHSA id where there is one, else the database's own (`PYSEC-...`, `RUSTSEC-...`).

index.description:
The technology's releases the ranges were resolved against (central's release index when the advisory was
attached). For a version in this list, `AffectedRange::versions` says whether it is affected; a version
outside it is unknown, and the edge says nothing about the advisory for it. Absent in catalogs before
15 October 2026 (the edge then says nothing about advisories).

severity.description: `low`, `medium`, `high` or `critical`, as the database states it.

AffectedRange.description: One affected range of an advisory for one package.

patched.description: The first version with the fix on this range's line, when there is one.

range.description:
The range for people (and edges before 15 October 2026): comparators joined by commas, e.g.
`>= 16.0.0, < 16.2.5`; empty when the database states the range only as a version list or commits.

versions.description:
The releases of `Advisory::index` this range affects, resolved centrally. Absent when central could not
resolve the range (no version order for the ecosystem and no explicit list): the edge then says nothing.

Benefit.description: Why the change matters, only where the source states or directly implies it.

oneOf.description:
Replaces code a project would otherwise write and maintain; counted at the edge only where the
record's `replaces` terms are present in the project.
Convenience, style, new capabilities, optional modernisation.

BenefitScore.description: A benefit value asked of the classifier and its probability.

CapabilityRecord.description: A live record. Fields bump `revision` (decision fields) or `label_version` (ordering labels).

advisories.description:
Reviewed security advisories whose fix this record describes, with the versions each affects. The edge
decides from these, not from `releases`, which advisories a bump fixes (backports included).

classifier.description: Classifier output for the label fields, read with its confidence.

conditions.description:
Requirements that cannot be checked from a manifest (a database server version). Shown to the
agent; never block the record.

ChangeType.description: What changed. Closed set; an unknown value reads as `Other`.

Classification.description: The classifier's probabilities and confidence for a record's label fields.

benefit.description: Probability per benefit value asked (security, correctness, performance, cost, maintainability).

borderline.description: Labels whose call is near the threshold (`breaking`, `benefit:security`, `change_type`, ...): flagged, never dropped.

breaking.description: Probability that the change is breaking.

change_type.description: Confidence of the chosen value, as returned by the classifier.

classifier.description: Which classifier answered: `jev`, `chat`, or (older records) `codex` or `openai-decisions`.

model.description: The model the API reported, e.g. `jev-1.13.0` or `gpt-6-luna`.

Classifier.description: Which classifier answered. Closed set; an unknown value reads as `Other`.

oneOf.description: Kept readable for records labelled before 15 October 2026; no longer called.
Kept readable for records labelled 15–16 October 2026 (Luna through `codex exec`); no longer called.
The fallback since 16 October 2026: the extraction chat model (gpt-6-luna) asked for choices only.

snapshot.description: `sha256:` plus the hex digest of the snapshot the quote was taken from.

oneOf.description: A security advisory (GitHub Advisory Database); the quote is its id and summary.

Prerequisite.description:
A machine-comparable requirement, named as a project's manifest declares it in that ecosystem,
e.g. `{"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "node", "min": "24.0"}` (`engines.node`) or
`{"ecosystem": "composer", "name": "php", "min": "8.2"}`. No alias table: the stack map reads the same keys.

Release.description: One release of the change on one release line.

component.description: Package URL of the component that shipped it, e.g. `pkg:npm/next`.

line.description:
The old release line, major (or 0.minor below 1.0): what edges before 16 October 2026 compare and what shards
are named by. A record may hold several releases on one such line (one per line of the tech index's
`releases`, which is the line to use).

Surface.description: Where the change shows in a project. Closed set; an unknown value reads as `Other`.

Term.description: A search term and the number of the technology's sample repositories that contain it.

description: One line of a shard. A merged or retracted record stays in its shard as a stub.
title: ShardLine
